verdict.rationale: Docs and SDK examples show enrichments built from natural-language prompts (e.g. "Research each company" with attributes CEO/Employee Count) that Riveter fills using AI agents interpreting pages, explicitly replacing selector-based scraping. This directly matches the story of extracting structured data via natural language rather than selectors. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of extraction accuracy and no third-party benchmarking of output quality beyond vendor docs.
